from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1'
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists() and not (OUT/'run_started.json').exists(),'该固定实验已有执行记录，禁止重复拟合。'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def clean(v):
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
 if isinstance(v,(list,tuple,np.ndarray)):return [clean(x) for x in v]
 if v is pd.NaT or v is pd.NA:return None
 if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime)):return v.isoformat()
 if isinstance(v,np.integer):return int(v)
 if isinstance(v,np.bool_):return bool(v)
 if isinstance(v,(float,np.floating)):return float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None
 return v
def save(name,v):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
def csv(name,f):f.to_csv(OUT/name,index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
freeze=json.loads((OUT/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));sg=json.loads((OUT/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sha(OUT/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
assert sg['all_16_sources_present'] and sg['all_prior_and_next_three_months_present']
assert sha(OUT/'季度长端计划状态.parquet')==sg['quarter_field_hash']
for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(ROOT/rel)==h,rel
for rel,h in sg['source_hashes'].items():assert sha(OUT/rel)==h,rel
save('run_started.json',{'started_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'protocol_sha256':freeze['protocol_sha256'],
 'quarter_field_sha256':sg['quarter_field_hash'],'single_fixed_run':True,'parameter_searches':0})
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'research'))
import multidim_money_surprise_score_v1 as model
assert model.TREE==protocol['tree']
code_receipt={str(Path('research/multidim_money_surprise_score_v1.py')):sha(ROOT/'research/multidim_money_surprise_score_v1.py')}
parent_dir=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score'
original=pd.read_parquet(parent_dir/'月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet').sort_values('decision_at').reset_index(drop=True)
assert len(original)==68
quarters=pd.read_parquet(OUT/'季度长端计划状态.parquet').sort_values('available_at').reset_index(drop=True)
field=protocol['one_feature']
eligibility=[]
for _,r in original.iterrows():
 source=quarters[quarters.available_at.le(r.decision_at)]
 item=r.to_dict()
 item['supply_eligible']=False;item['supply_reason']='当前日期之前无已登记季度来源'
 item[field]=np.nan;item['supply_quarter']=None;item['supply_available_at']=pd.NaT
 item['supply_source_url']=None;item['supply_source_sha256']=None;item['supply_age_days']=np.nan
 if len(source):
  q=source.iloc[-1];age=(r.decision_at-q.available_at).total_seconds()/86400
  item.update({field:float(q[field]),'supply_quarter':q.quarter,'supply_available_at':q.available_at,
    'supply_source_url':q.source_url,'supply_source_sha256':q.source_sha256,'supply_age_days':age})
  if age<=120 and 2022<=r.decision_at.year<=2025:
   item['supply_eligible']=True;item['supply_reason']='公布日代理已知，未超过120天'
  else:item['supply_reason']='来源超过120天或事件不在登记年份'
 eligibility.append(item)
all_events=pd.DataFrame(eligibility)
all_events['统计月份正弦']=np.sin(2*np.pi*all_events.stat_month.str[5:].astype(int)/12)
all_events['统计月份余弦']=np.cos(2*np.pi*all_events.stat_month.str[5:].astype(int)/12)
all_events['era']=np.where(all_events.decision_at.dt.year.ge(2024),'2024—2025','2022—2023')
all_events.to_parquet(OUT/'全部68事件及来源准入.parquet',index=False);csv('全部68事件及来源准入.csv',all_events)
events=all_events[all_events.supply_eligible].copy()
assert events[field].notna().all() and (events.supply_available_at<=events.decision_at).all()
events.to_parquet(OUT/'共同事件长端供给状态及原标签.parquet',index=False)
def path(tree,current):
 node=0;steps=[]
 while tree['children_left'][node]!=tree['children_right'][node]:
  idx=tree['feature'][node];name=tree['features'][idx];value=float(np.float32(current[name]))
  threshold=float(tree['threshold'][node]);left=value<=threshold
  steps.append({'node':node,'field':name,'value':float(current[name]),'float32_comparison_value':value,'threshold':threshold,'direction':'left' if left else 'right'})
  node=tree['children_left'][node] if left else tree['children_right'][node]
 return node,steps
def linear(pool,current,features):
 x=pool[features].to_numpy(float);y=pool.actual_net5.to_numpy(float)
 mean=x.mean(axis=0);scale=x.std(axis=0,ddof=1);scale[scale<1e-12]=1
 z=np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-5,5);zmean=z.mean(axis=0);centered=z-zmean
 coef=np.linalg.solve(centered.T@centered+10*np.eye(len(features)),centered.T@(y-y.mean()))
 prediction=float(y.mean()+(np.clip((current[features].to_numpy(float)-mean)/scale,-5,5)-zmean)@coef)
 return prediction,{'features':features,'mean':mean,'scale':scale,'zmean':zmean,'coef':coef,'ymean':float(y.mean())}
rows=[];models=[];excluded=[];leaf_records=[];path_records=[];max_replay_error=0.;max_score_error=0.
for _,current in events.iterrows():
 pool=events[events.state_idx.ge(current.state_idx-504)&events.exit_at.le(current.decision_at)]
 if len(pool)<12:
  excluded.append({'stat_month':current.stat_month,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'mature_events':len(pool),'reason':'固定12次成熟事件未满足'});continue
 assert pool.stat_month.ne(current.stat_month).all() and pool.exit_at.le(current.decision_at).all()
 assert (pool.supply_available_at<=pool.decision_at).all() and pool[field].notna().all()
 cp,cs,ct=model.fit_tree(pool,current,protocol['features_control'])
 jp,js,jt=model.fit_tree(pool,current,protocol['features_joint'])
 lp,lm=linear(pool,current,protocol['features_joint'])
 current_path_fields={}
 for kind,prediction,score,tree in [('control',cp,cs,ct),('joint',jp,js,jt)]:
  leaf,steps=path(tree,current);members=[];fitted=[]
  for _,training in pool.iterrows():
   training_leaf,_=path(tree,training);fitted.append(float(tree['value'][training_leaf]))
   if training_leaf==leaf:
    members.append(training)
    leaf_records.append({'model':kind,'prediction_stat_month':current.stat_month,'decision_at':current.decision_at,
     'leaf':leaf,'training_stat_month':training.stat_month,'training_entry_date':training.entry_date,'training_exit_date':training.exit_date,
     'training_exit_at':training.exit_at,'training_actual_net5':training.actual_net5,'training_supply_growth':training[field],
     'training_supply_quarter':training.supply_quarter,'training_supply_available_at':training.supply_available_at})
  replay=float(pd.DataFrame(members).actual_net5.mean())
  rank=float(100*((np.array(fitted)<prediction).mean()+.5*(np.array(fitted)==prediction).mean()))
  max_replay_error=max(max_replay_error,abs(replay-prediction));max_score_error=max(max_score_error,abs(rank-score))
  fields=[x['field'] for x in steps];current_path_fields[kind]=fields
  path_records.append({'model':kind,'stat_month':current.stat_month,'decision_at':current.decision_at,
    'supply_quarter':current.supply_quarter,'supply_growth':current[field],'prediction':prediction,'score':score,
    'leaf':leaf,'path':steps,'member_months':[s.stat_month for s in members],
    'member_supply_quarters':sorted({s.supply_quarter for s in members}),'supply_field_actually_used':field in fields})
 record=current.to_dict()
 record.update(control_prediction=cp,control_score=cs,joint_prediction=jp,joint_score=js,
  linear_prediction=lp,mean_prediction=float(pool.actual_net5.mean()),training_events=len(pool),
  training_months=';'.join(pool.stat_month),training_max_exit_at=pool.exit_at.max(),
  training_quarter_roots=int(pool.supply_quarter.nunique()),
  supply_any_tree_node=field in jt['used_features'],supply_on_actual_path=field in current_path_fields['joint'],
  control_path_fields='；'.join(current_path_fields['control']),joint_path_fields='；'.join(current_path_fields['joint']))
 rows.append(record)
 models.append({'stat_month':current.stat_month,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'training_months':pool.stat_month.tolist(),
  'training_supply_quarters':pool.supply_quarter.tolist(),'control_tree':ct,'joint_tree':jt,'linear':lm})
pred=pd.DataFrame(rows)
assert len(pred)>0 and len(pred)<=len(events)
csv('逐事件长端供给联合评分.csv',pred);save('saved_models.json',models);save('未评分的成熟事件.json',excluded)
csv('全部训练叶成员.csv',pd.DataFrame(leaf_records));save('全部实际路径.json',path_records)
buckets=[];errors=[];opportunities=[]
for kind in ['control','joint']:
 next_at=pd.Timestamp('1900-01-01',tz='Asia/Shanghai')
 for _,row in pred.iterrows():
  if row.decision_at<next_at or row[kind+'_score']<80 or row[kind+'_prediction']<=0:continue
  opportunities.append({'model':kind,'stat_month':row.stat_month,'era':row.era,'signal_date':row.decision_at,
   'entry_date':row.entry_date,'exit_date':row.exit_date,'score':row[kind+'_score'],'prediction':row[kind+'_prediction'],
   'net_return':row.actual_net5,'supply_growth':row[field],'supply_quarter':row.supply_quarter,
   'supply_on_actual_path':row.supply_on_actual_path if kind=='joint' else False,'actual_path_fields':row[kind+'_path_fields']})
  next_at=row.exit_at
 for era,block in pred.groupby('era',sort=False):
  bands=np.minimum((block[kind+'_score']/20).astype(int),4)
  for band in range(5):
   selected=block.loc[bands.eq(band)]
   buckets.append({'model':kind,'era':era,'score_band':f'{band*20}—{(band+1)*20}',
    **model.return_summary(selected.actual_net5),'quarter_roots':int(selected.supply_quarter.nunique())})
for era,block in pred.groupby('era',sort=False):
 for kind in ['control','joint','linear','mean']:
  errors.append({'era':era,'model':kind,'mse':float(((block[kind+'_prediction']-block.actual_net5)**2).mean()),'n':len(block)})
opp=pd.DataFrame(opportunities,columns=['model','stat_month','era','signal_date','entry_date','exit_date','score','prediction',
 'net_return','supply_growth','supply_quarter','supply_on_actual_path','actual_path_fields'])
summary=[];annual=[]
for kind in ['control','joint']:
 for era in ['2022—2023','2024—2025']:
  selected=opp[opp.model.eq(kind)&opp.era.eq(era)]
  summary.append({'model':kind,'era':era,**model.return_summary(selected.net_return),'quarter_roots':int(selected.supply_quarter.nunique())})
 for year in range(2022,2026):
  selected=opp[opp.model.eq(kind)&pd.to_datetime(opp.entry_date).dt.year.eq(year)]
  annual.append({'model':kind,'year':year,**model.return_summary(selected.net_return)})
csv('同事件全部五档比较.csv',pd.DataFrame(buckets));csv('四项模型误差.csv',pd.DataFrame(errors))
csv('全部固定高分机会.csv',opp);csv('高分机会比较.csv',pd.DataFrame(summary));csv('高分机会逐年次数.csv',pd.DataFrame(annual))
primary=pred[pred.era.eq('2024—2025')];earlier=pred[pred.era.eq('2022—2023')]
assert len(primary)>0
jhigh=opp[opp.model.eq('joint')&opp.era.eq('2024—2025')];chigh=opp[opp.model.eq('control')&opp.era.eq('2024—2025')]
parent_opp=pd.read_csv(parent_dir/'全部固定高分机会.csv');phigh=parent_opp[parent_opp.model.eq('joint')&parent_opp.era.eq('2024—2025')]
def windowset(f):return set((pd.Timestamp(x.entry_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),pd.Timestamp(x.exit_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) for x in f.itertuples())
parent_windows=windowset(phigh);control_windows=windowset(chigh)
newhigh=jhigh[[ (pd.Timestamp(x.entry_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),pd.Timestamp(x.exit_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) not in (parent_windows|control_windows) for x in jhigh.itertuples()]] if len(jhigh) else jhigh.copy()
csv('主期不同于原模型及匹配对照的机会.csv',newhigh)
jmse=float(((primary.joint_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean());cmse=float(((primary.control_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean())
jmean=float(jhigh.net_return.mean()) if len(jhigh) else None;cmean=float(chigh.net_return.mean()) if len(chigh) else None
gates={
 'primary_joint_mse_not_worse_than_matched_control':jmse<=cmse,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_net5_positive':jmean is not None and jmean>0,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_not_worse_than_matched_control_when_nonempty':jmean is not None and (cmean is None or jmean>=cmean),
 'at_least_one_primary_joint_high_date_not_in_control_or_parent_M2':len(newhigh)>0,
 'at_least_one_primary_new_high_path_actually_uses_supply_field':len(newhigh)>0 and bool(newhigh.supply_on_actual_path.any())}
gate=all(gates.values())
assert max_replay_error<1e-12 and max_score_error<1e-10
unchanged={rel:sha(ROOT/rel)==h for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items()};assert all(unchanged.values())
source_unchanged={rel:sha(OUT/rel)==h for rel,h in sg['source_hashes'].items()};assert all(source_unchanged.values())
assert all(sha(ROOT/rel)==h for rel,h in code_receipt.items())
verification={'source_quarters':16,'all_event_sources_known_before_decision':True,'all_training_labels_mature':True,
 'full_68_event_set_preserved':len(all_events)==68,'common_scored_pool_for_all_models':True,
 'max_leaf_mean_error':max_replay_error,'max_percentile_score_error':max_score_error,'input_hashes_unchanged':unchanged,
 'source_hashes_unchanged':source_unchanged,'existing_model_source_hashes':code_receipt,
 'original_repository_code_modified':False,'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,
 'causal_identification_established':False,'independent_validation':False}
save('必要复核.json',verification)
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E6','completed_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
 'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_LONG_SUPPLY_SCORE_ACCOUNT_ADMISSION_PASSED' if gate else 'REJECTED_FROZEN_LONG_SUPPLY_INCREMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_SINGLE_UPSTREAM_STATE_INCREMENT_TEST','source_quarter_roots':16,'source_objects':sg['source_objects'],
 'original_event_universe':68,'source_eligible_events':len(events),'source_ineligible_events':len(all_events)-len(events),
 'scored_events':len(pred),'source_eligible_but_insufficient_mature_events':len(excluded),
 'primary_scored_events':len(primary),'earlier_scored_events':len(earlier),
 'scored_quarter_roots':int(pred.supply_quarter.nunique()),'primary_quarter_roots':int(primary.supply_quarter.nunique()),
 'primary_growth_values':sorted(primary[field].unique().tolist()),'primary_zero_growth_events':int(primary[field].eq(0).sum()),
 'new_supply_field':field,'common_calendar_controls':2,'matched_control_fields':11,'joint_fields':12,
 'tree_configuration':protocol['tree'],'new_model_families':3,'fits_per_family':len(pred),'total_new_fits':3*len(pred),'parameter_searches':0,
 'supply_any_node_events':int(pred.supply_any_tree_node.sum()),'supply_actual_path_events':int(pred.supply_on_actual_path.sum()),
 'primary_supply_actual_path_events':int(primary.supply_on_actual_path.sum()),'primary_joint_mse':jmse,'primary_control_mse':cmse,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_net5':jmean,'primary_control_high_mean_net5':cmean,'primary_joint_high_count':len(jhigh),'primary_control_high_count':len(chigh),
 'primary_new_high_count':len(newhigh),'primary_new_high_months':newhigh.stat_month.tolist(),
 'primary_new_high_supply_path_count':int(newhigh.supply_on_actual_path.sum()),
 'same_primary_predictions_as_matched_control':int(np.isclose(primary.joint_prediction,primary.control_prediction,atol=1e-12,rtol=0).sum()),
 'gate_components':gates,'full_account_admission_passed':gate,'buckets':buckets,'model_errors':errors,
 'opportunity_summary':summary,'annual_opportunities':annual,'new_accounts':0,'account_net_sharpe':None,'goal_achieved':False,
 'independent_validation':False,'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'new_repository_code_edits':0}
save('result.json',result)
print(json.dumps(clean({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['buckets','annual_opportunities']}),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('主期全部高分机会：');print(opp[opp.era.eq('2024—2025')].to_string(index=False))
